explanation: The act by which God restores the relationship between Himself and humanity through Jesus' death, turning enmity into peace.
The term describing the radical transformation a believer experiences; when one is in Christ, the old has passed away and something new has come.
A messenger or representative from the King (God) who has authority to deliver the message of peace and reconciliation on behalf of His Lord.
The term referring to the task given to the apostles, namely to be God's instruments in bringing people back to Him.
The future act in which God will evaluate all people's lives and deeds based on justice and truth.
The term describing the eternal, invisible reality in heaven that believers look forward to, as opposed to the temporary life here on earth.
